def solution():
    high_prices = [150, 152, 153]
    low_prices = [145, 148, 149]
    closing_prices = [148, 150, 151]
    volumes = [2000, 3500, 5000]

    typical_prices = [
        (high + low + close) / 3
        for high, low, close in zip(high_prices, low_prices, closing_prices)
    ]
    total_value = sum(price * volume for price, volume in zip(typical_prices, volumes))
    total_volume = sum(volumes)
    answer = round(total_value / total_volume, 2)

    return answer
